data.name: Board game party
data.detailed_description:
This is a unique 3D game that integrates numerous classic board games, creating an entirely new gaming world for you. In this world, you can choose to engage in intense online battles with friends or strangers on the internet, compete strategically against intelligent AI, or share the joy of gaming with your friends in local mode.

The game features include:

1. The game includes a rich variety of board games, including:

  • Connect Four: Players take turns dropping pieces into a 7×6 grid, aiming to be the first to connect 4 pieces of the same color horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.

  • Yacht dice: Players take turns rolling dice to form number combinations. Five of a kind is called "Yacht" and scores the highest. The player with the most points wins.

  • Gomoku: Players take turns placing pieces on the board, aiming to be the first to connect 5 pieces of the same color in any direction to win. Simple rules but high strategic depth.

  • Dots and Boxes: Players take turns connecting line segments on a grid. When completing a box, they gain ownership of that box. The player with the most boxes wins.

  • Mastermind: A logic puzzle game where a 4-color code is set at the beginning. Players try to crack the code combination through limited guesses and feedback information.

  • Checkers: Move pieces on the board, jumping over opponent's pieces to capture them. The goal is to capture all opponent pieces or make them unable to move.

  • RailMind: Place pieces on tracks, aiming to be the first to connect 4 pieces of the same color horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to win.

  • Hex: The goal is to be the first to connect the edges of your color across the board in a line.

  • Blackjack: Classic card game where players compare hand values with the dealer, aiming to get as close to 21 as possible without going over.

  • Memory Chess: Remember the patterns of various pieces on the board, score by flipping matching pattern pieces. The player with the highest score after flipping all pieces wins.

  • Backgammon: Ancient board game where players roll dice to move pieces, aiming to move all their pieces off the board. A classic game combining luck and strategy.

  • Snakes and Ladders: Move forward on a 100-square board by rolling dice. Encounter ladders to climb quickly, encounter snake heads to slide down. First to reach the end wins.

  • Triangle Nexus: Players take turns placing rubber bands on posts, forming triangles on the board and inserting their pieces into holes to occupy them.

2. The game supports multiple gameplay modes:

  • Single-player mode, enjoy the independent fun of gaming.

  • Local play, share the joy of gaming with friends.

  • Online battles, compete with players worldwide.

  • Support remote play.

3. The game supports multiple input modes to make your gaming experience more colorful.

Whether you prefer using mouse and keyboard or game controllers, you can find the most suitable operation method for you and switch at any time.

4. The game features realistic 3D graphics.

Simulates real-world gaming effects, bringing you an immersive gaming experience. Every detail is carefully designed to make you feel as if you're in a real game.

5. The game supports free switching between local and online game modes.

You can play single-player while waiting for matches, without wasting any time, making your gaming experience smoother.

This game will bring you an unprecedented gaming experience, letting you find joy in board games, challenge yourself, and compete with players worldwide.
